title: Auto-generate privacy policy + impressum content from site.config (no manual page editing)
description: Automate legal pages fully from site.config so forks never hand-edit them. Impressum already renders from siteConfig.legal. Privacy: replace the placeholder page with a GDPR-shaped policy GENERATED from config + actual app behavior: controller = legal.entity/address, contact = legal.privacyContact; processing sections conditional on what is enabled (auth cookies always; GA4/PostHog sections only when the env keys are set, mirroring lib/analytics.ts consent gating); consent/withdrawal section references the cookie banner. Visible 'generated from site.config, review with counsel before launch' note. README checklist items become 'fill site.config.legal' + 'review generated pages'. Blocked by the i18n locale lane: policy copy goes through i18n messages in all locales.

title: register.test.tsx asserts literal English copy (breaks i18n test doctrine)
description: register.test.tsx lines ~136-146 assert literal strings ('Invalid email address', 'Password should contain at least one uppercase letter.'). Tests must assert keys/behavior, not translated values; this coupled the suite to the active locale and caused a flaky interaction (mitigated by afterEach setLocale('en') in locale-provider.test). Fix: assert via message keys or testids.

title: Zero-config demo mode for the chat FAB (public demo endpoint)
description: When ContextRocket's public demo mode ships, default the FAB's first-run experience to it: clone, start, and chat works immediately against a rate-limited showcase org, no credential required. Setting your own org credential remains the upgrade path. Update README and docs/integrating-with-contextrocket.md when it lands.

title: Fix flaky use-a2a-stream test: setState after teardown race
description: hooks/use-a2a-stream.ts:307 setStreamingText fires after test teardown; the streaming test does not await/abort the stream in cleanup. Intermittent ELIFECYCLE suite failure observed 2026-08-01 (passes on rerun). Fix: wrap stream advancement in act() or abort the stream in afterEach. A public template must have zero-flake tests.

title: Wire ChatPanel through cr-sdk end-to-end (ensureToken auto-runs before streamTurn)
description: Behavior-preserving polish: the hook takes bearerToken via clientOpts today and works; the cleaner shape is the panel calling createCRClient().streamTurn(). See docs/sharpening-plan.md Residuals.
